items.ai_summary: swyx 认为外界未正确计算 SpaceX 收购 Cursor 的财务逻辑：已通过算力交易收回一半投资，另一半取决于 Composer 3 表现；Cursor 是唯一同时是模型实验室和 neocloud 的公司。
items.brief: swyx 认为外界未正确计算 SpaceX 收购 Cursor 的财务逻辑：已通过算力交易收回一半投资，另一半取决于 Composer 3 表现；Cursor 是唯一同时是模型实验室和 neocloud 的公司。
items.social_original_text:
i dont think anyone is correctly doing the math around how SpaceX, the NeoCloud+NeoLab, is currently going to market?

SpaceX has already recouped about HALF its investment in Cursor, in compute deals. The other half is paid for if Composer 3 does well.

No other company is simultaneously a leading model lab + neocloud (at least where GPUs is concerned). its a crazy effective combo iff you've adequately planned out gpu supply if inhouse training 1) goes very well 2) doesn't go very well
items.translation_zh: 我认为没有人正确计算过SpaceX（即NeoCloud+NeoLab）目前如何进入市场？ SpaceX已经通过计算交易收回了大约一半对Cursor的投资。如果Composer 3表现良好，另一半也能收回。 没有其他公司同时是领先的模型实验室和neocloud（至少在GPU方面）。这是一个极其有效的组合，前提是你已经充分规划了GPU供应，无论内部训练1）进展顺利，2）进展不顺利。

items.title: Almost all AI model and agent progress is downstream from evals. Open weights post training for specific domains comes down to evals. Agent improvements in the applied AI layer is all about evals. Agentic enterprise depl
items.ai_summary: 推文作者认为，几乎所有AI模型和Agent的进步都依赖于评估（evals），包括开放权重后训练、Agent改进和企业部署，未来企业核心能力是理解工作流并评估Agent参与度。
items.brief: 推文作者认为，几乎所有AI模型和Agent的进步都依赖于评估（evals），包括开放权重后训练、Agent改进和企业部署，未来企业核心能力是理解工作流并评估Agent参与度。
items.social_original_text:
Almost all AI model and agent progress is downstream from evals. Open weights post training for specific domains comes down to evals. Agent improvements in the applied AI layer is all about evals. Agentic enterprise deployments that actually can augment work is all about evals. It’s all evals.

This will become a core competency of any enterprise in the future. The companies that are able to best understand their own (and/or customers) workflows and how well agents participate in that work will be in the best position to actually drive real automation.
items.translation_zh: 几乎所有AI模型和智能体的进步都依赖于评估。针对特定领域的开放权重后训练归结为评估。应用AI层的智能体改进完全取决于评估。能够真正增强工作的企业级智能体部署也完全取决于评估。一切都是评估。 这将成为未来任何企业的核心竞争力。那些最能理解自身（和/或客户）工作流程以及智能体如何参与其中的公司，将处于最佳位置，真正实现自动化。
